findings.title: Test failure after selecting a worksheet
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the session test to call selectWorksheet, assert that the second import request carries the chosen worksheet, respond with a worker error, and verify the committed view and export remain available. Then select and complete a valid replacement to verify the commit transition.

findings.title: Separate worksheet and delimiter status branches
findings.suggested_fix: Build the complete source detail before rendering: for Excel use `worksheet ${view.worksheet}`; for CSV use the current delimiter label followed by `delimiter detected`. Interpolate that complete detail into the shared row-count/status sentence.
findings.first_evidence: src/ui/Workspace.tsx:335:               ? `Source loaded · ${view.summary.candidates.toLocaleString()} candidate rows · ${view.worksheet ? `worksheet ${view.worksheet}` : view.delimiter === "\t" ? "tab" : view.delimiter === ";" ? "semicolon" : "comma"} delimiter detected. Verify the source columns below.`

findings.title: Fresh workbooks silently reuse the previous worksheet
findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish a fresh manual replacement from an activated saved workflow. Use options.worksheet for an explicit choice, options.workflow?.source.worksheet for explicit workflow reuse, and this.workflow?.source.worksheet only when no source run is active (the activated-workflow case). Leave worksheet undefined for a manual replacement so a multi-sheet workbook prompts for selection. Verify same-name and missing-name replacement cases.
findings.first_evidence: src/session/controller.ts:141:       const worksheet = options.worksheet ?? (options.template ? undefined : (options.workflow ?? this.workflow)?.source.worksheet);

findings.title: Worksheet choice leaks into the next workbook
findings.suggested_fix: Clear the local worksheet choice whenever a new file is submitted or a new worksheet list is presented, including destination templates. Preserve automatic reuse only through the explicit saved-workflow worksheet sent to the session. Add a UI check that choosing a source sheet called Orders does not preselect Orders in a subsequent multi-sheet template.
